inputs.text: [excited] Its open wings spanned 11 meters wingtip to wingtip — as wide as a city bus! [quickly] Laid end to end, as long as a city bus too. Standing up, it was 5 meters tall — [proud] almost as tall as three Dads standing on each other's shoulders! And it weighed 200 kilos — as heavy as a lion. [amazed] And flying, scientists think it could go 56 miles an hour — almost as fast as a cheetah.
[proud] Exactly. [amazed] And yet, this animal could fly.
